_what: How the Models tab labels and limits a role's attributes, per model family (Jas, 2026-09-29: the fields 'should reflect the model's design'). Whether a model can think at all comes from Ollama's /api/show capabilities, never from here; this file only says what the family CALLS it and which values it takes, with the source.

qwen.name: Qwen
qwen.source: Qwen3.8 model card (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B): reasoning effort levels; settings.py coder profile note: 'high' measured to return done=stop, 2026-09-12

think.label: Reasoning effort
think.help: Reasoning tokens come out of the same budget as the reply (see 'Longest reply'). Higher effort: better judgement, slower, and needs a bigger reply budget.

gemma.name: Gemma
gemma.source: Gemma 4 model card (https://ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/core/model_card_4); settings.py 2026-09-14: think=high and think=low both answered on gemma4:26b

think.label: Thinking
think.help: Measured 2026-09-14: 'high' took 18.8 s and 'low' 1.2 s for the same one-word answer. With thinking on, a small reply budget can come back empty.

unprofiled_think.label: Thinking (no profile for this family yet)
unprofiled_think.help: Ollama says this model can think, but nobody has written its family's profile yet; these are Ollama's generic levels.

num_ctx.label: Context window (tokens)
num_ctx.help: Everything the model holds at once: the prompt, the files, and its reply. Bigger costs memory and start-up time.

num_predict.label: Longest reply before it must stop (tokens)
num_predict.help: Includes reasoning tokens. -1 means no limit.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.help: Blank = the model card's own value (recommended). 0 = the same answer every time.

keep_alive.label: Keep loaded after use
keep_alive.help: -1 keeps it in memory until something else needs the room.
